name: swipeable-row
summary: A mail-style row whose actions fan out and grow as you drag it sideways.
props: Revealed by swiping right; the first is the edge (full-swipe) action.
Revealed by swiping left; the last is the edge (full-swipe) action.
destructive collapses the row before calling onPress.
Width of each action when resting open.
Swiping past half the row fires the edge action.
Spring closed after an action is tapped.
Style of the sliding foreground — keep its background opaque.
Style for the outer row that holds the actions behind the sliding content.
behavior: Drag sideways to reveal the actions; a full swipe past half the row fires the edge action. Tap the open row to close it.
Actions fan out and grow with your finger, the edge action stretches across on a full swipe, and destructive actions slide away and collapse the row.
Every action is offered as a named accessibility action on the row, and each revealed action is a labelled button.
Built on PanResponder, so a mouse drag works too; the row shows a grab cursor and text selection is turned off.
